name: Autonomous Driving
description:
The module teaches the basics of "Automated Driving", establishes a current reference to science and practice, discusses central issues and provides exemplary solution approaches for these, which the students learn to apply fundamentally.

Overview:

Application scenarios for "autonomous vehicles" in various domains (road, rail transport, aviation)
System architecture for "autonomous vehicles"
Sensor technology for perception 
Multisensor data fusion at different levels, 
Map creation and localization 
Object recognition with ML methods 
Functional and operational safety
Legal and normative framework conditions (e.g. EU AI Act)
Concerns about the use of ML processes and measures to ensure trustworthiness
Ensuring data quality for the training, testing and validation of functions implemented with ML 
Development processes for "autonomous vehicles"

Presentations by experts from the industry reinforce the current practical relevance
prerequisites:
Linear Algebra for Computer Science (MA0901)
Discrete Probability Theory (IN0018)
